newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK TATRA BANKA SIGNS KAZAKH OIL PROJECT LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK TATRA BANKA SIGNS KAZAKH OIL PROJECT LOAN.

text.p: Slovak Tatra Banka a.s. on Wednesday signed Slovakia's first-ever syndicated hard currency loan, a four-year $13.5 million credit with Slovak-Kazakhstan oil exploitation joint-venture J-SC ANACO a.s..

"The loan will be used to finance the Slovak-Kazakhstan project for the construction of oil drilling sites in Kazakhstan's Kyrykmyltyk by J-SC ANACO," General Director of Tatra Banka Milan Vrskovy said at the signing ceremony.
The joint-venture was set up for the extraction of crude oil in Kazakhstan.

The project includes the construction of 22 drilling sites and a 35 km branch pipeline between the oilfield in Kyrykmyltyk, with a capacity of some 4.8 million tonnes of exploitable crude oil, and the Russian Yuzhnefteprovod oil pipeline.
Slovakia's biggest oil refinery Slovnaft a.s. has already signed a preliminary contract with J-SC ANACO to purchase oil from Kyrykmyltyk, through the Nafta a.s. branch in Kazakhstan.
